verdict.rationale: Grafana's core product is dashboard building with template variables (dropdown reusable variables per grafana-gh-3), rich panel/visualization plugins (grafana-gh-8, grafana-docs-30), multi-datasource mixing (grafana-gh-4/6), and provisioning/version control for GitOps-style shareable dashboards (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-11, grafana-docs-16). Community evidence corroborates real-world dashboard/graph consolidation usage (grafana-comm-4) though one user notes dashboard creation/documentation friction (grafana-comm-3) and a niche visualization limitation (grafana-comm-6). Missing for 10: deeper first-party detail on dashboard sharing/permissions mechanics and more independent validation of template variable robustness at scale.
